Aur sitaray sab ke sab gir parenge aur khari aur meethe samundar aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Aur pani sookh jayega, qabrein phat jayengi, un ke shaq hone ke baad murday jee uthenge, phir har shakhs apne aglay pichlay a'maal ko bakhoobi jaan lega. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko dhamkata hai ke tum kyun maghroor ho gaye ho? Yeh nahin ke Allah Ta'ala is ka jawab talab karta ho ya sikhata ho, ba'az ne yeh bhi kaha hai balkay unhon ne jawab diya hai ke Allah ke karam ne ghafil kar rakha hai, yeh ma'ani bayan karne ghalat hain, sahih matlab yahi hai ke aye Ibn-e-Adam! Apne ba-azmat Allah se tu ne kyun be-parwahi barat rakhi hai? Kis cheez ne tujhe us ki nafarmani par uksa rakha hai? Aur kyun tu us ke muqablay par aamada ho gaya hai? Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala farmayega, aye Ibn-e-Adam! Tujhe meri janib se kisi cheez ne maghroor kar rakha tha? Ibn-e-Adam! Bata tu ne mere Nabiyon ko kya jawab diya? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne ek shakhs ko is aayat ki tilawat karte hue suna to farmaya ke insani jahalat ne ise ghafil bana rakha hai, Ibn-e-Umar, Ibn-e-Abbas waghera se bhi yahi marwi hai, Qatada farmate hain ise behkane wala Shaitan hai, Hazrat Fuzail Ibn-e-Iyad (R.H) farmate hain ke agar mujh se yeh sawal ho to main jawab dunga ke tere latkaye hue pardon ne. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain main to kahunga ke Kareem ke karam ne be-fikr kar diya, ba'az sukhan-shanas farmate hain ke yahan par Kareem ka lafz lana goya jawab ki taraf ishara sikhana hai. Lekin yeh qaul kuch faydemand nahin balkay sahih matlab yeh hai ke karam walon ko Allah ke karam ke muqablay mein bad-af'aal aur buray a'maal na karne chahiyein. Kalbi aur Muqatil farmate hain ke Aswad bin Shariq ke baray mein yeh nazil hui hai. Is khabeeth ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mara tha aur usi waqt chunke us par kuch azaab na aaya to woh phool gaya, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Phir farmata hai woh Allah jis ne tujhe paida kiya, phir durust banaya, phir darmiyana qad-o-qamat bakhsha, khush-shakal aur khoobsurat banaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni hatheli mein thooka phir us par apni ungli rakh kar farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aye Ibn-e-Adam! Kya tu mujhe aajiz kar sakta hai? Halankeh main ne tujhe is jaisi cheez se paida kiya hai, phir theek-thaak kiya, phir sahih qamat banaya, phir tujhe pehna orha kar chalna phirna sikhaya, aakhir-kaar tera thikana zameen ke andar hai, tu ne khoob daulat jama ki aur meri raah mein dene se baaz raha, yahan tak ke jab dam halq mein aa gaya to kehne laga main sadaqa karta hoon, bhala ab sadaqay ka waqt kahan? Jis surat mein chaha tarkeeb di, ya'ni baap ki, maa ki, mamoon ki, chacha ki surat mein paida kiya. Ek shakhs se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere han bacha kya hoga? Us ne kaha ya larka ya larki.

Farmaya kis ke mushabah hoga? Kaha ya mere ya us ki maa ke. Farmaya khamosh aisa na keh, nutfa jab raham mein thaharta hai to Hazrat Adam A.S tak ka nasab us ke samne hota hai. Phir aap ne aayat (Fi ayyi suratin ma sha'a rakkabak) parhi aur farmaya jis surat mein us ne chaha tujhe chalaya. Yeh hadith agar sahih hoti to aayat ke ma'ani karne ke liye kafi thi lekin is ki asnad sabit nahin hai. Mazhar bin Husam jo is ke rawi hain yeh matrook-ul-hadith hain. Un par aur jarah bhi hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aa kar kaha meri biwi ko jo bacha hua hai woh siyah-faam hai. Aap ne farmaya tere paas oont bhi hain? Kaha haan. Farmaya kis rang ke hain? Kaha surkh rang ke. Farmaya ke un mein koi chit-kabra bhi hai? Kaha haan. Farmaya us ka rang ka bacha surkh nar-o-mada ke darmiyan kaise paida ho gaya? Kehne laga shayad upar ki nasl ki taraf koi rag khench le gayi ho. Aap ne farmaya isi tarah tere bache ke siyah rang ke hone ki wajah bhi shayad yahi ho. Hazrat Ikrama R.H farmate hain agar chahe bandar ki surat bana de agar chahe soor ki. Abu Saleh R.H farmate hain agar chahe kutte ki surat mein bana de agar chahe gadhe ki agar chahe soor ki. Qatada R.H farmate hain yeh sab sach hai aur Allah har cheez par qadir hai lekin woh Malik hamein behtareen, umda, khush-shakal aur dil-lubhane wali pakeeza pakeeza shaklein suratein ata farmata hai. Phir farmata hai ke us Kareem Allah ki nafarmaniyon par tumhein amada karne wali cheez sirf yahi hai ke tumhare dilon mein Qayamat ki takzeeb hai, tum us ka aana hi barhaq nahin jante is liye us se be-parwahi barat rahe ho. Tum yaqeen mano ke tum par buzurg muhafiz aur katib farishte muqarrar hain. Tumhein chahiye ke un ka lihaz rakho, woh tumhare aamal likh rahe hain, tumhein burai karte hue sharm aani chahiye. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah ke yeh buzurg farishte tum se janabat aur pakhana ki halat ke siwa kisi waqt alag nahin hote. Tum un ka ehtram karo, ghusl ke waqt bhi parda kar liya karo, deewar se ya oat se hi sahi, yeh bhi na ho to apne kisi sathi ko khara kar liya karo taake wahi parda ho jaye (Ibn Abi Hatim). Bazzar ki is hadith ke alfaz mein kuch taghayyur-o-tabaddul hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhein nanga hone se mana karta hai. Allah ke in farishton se sharmao. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke ghusl ke waqt bhi yeh farishte door ho jate hain. Ek hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Kiraman Katibeen bande ke rozana aamal Allah Ta'ala ke samne pesh karte hain to agar shuru aur aakhir mein istighfar ho to Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke is ke darmiyan ki sab khatayen main ne apne ghulam ki bakhsh dein (Bazzar). Bazzar ki ek aur za'eef hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke ba'az farishte insanon ko aur un ke aamal ko jante pehchante hain, jab kisi bande ko neki mein mashghool pate hain to aapas mein kehte hain ke aaj ki raat falan shakhs nijat pa gaya, falah hasil kar gaya aur is ke khilaf dekhte hain to aapas mein zikr karte hain aur kehte hain ke aaj ki raat falan halak hua.
